JIRA_BLOCK: Hiring card step label: the Jira block.
JIRA_PAGE: Hiring card step label: the Jira page.
CALENDAR_AMBIGUOUS: Hiring evidence: more than one calendar event could match.
CALENDAR_UNAVAILABLE: Hiring evidence: the calendar could not be read.
CONFIRM_REJECTED: Decision action word: the rejection was confirmed.
CONTAINER_AMBIGUOUS: More than one destination container matches.
DECISION_AMBIGUOUS: Hiring evidence: more than one decision could apply.
DECISION_PENDING: A decision is still being written.
DEGRADED_SOURCE_INCOMPLETE: A source was only partly read.
EVENT_NOT_ON_CALENDAR: A scheduled event is no longer on the calendar.
HIRED_REOPEN_UNCONFIRMED: Reopening a Hired opportunity needs a second confirmation.
HISTORY_FULL: The history area is full, so no more is written.
IDENTITY_AMBIGUOUS: Hiring evidence: the identity is ambiguous.
LEDGER_INCOMPLETE: The Ledger read did not finish.
LEDGER_UNAPPLIED: A Ledger row for this decision was not applied.
LEDGER_UNAVAILABLE: Hiring evidence: the Ledger could not be read.
NOT_LEDGER_ROW: The page is not a Ledger row.
OPPORTUNITIES_UNAVAILABLE: Hiring evidence: the opportunities could not be read.
PAGES_INCOMPLETE: A page listing did not finish.
PAGE_UNPROVEN: The page could not be proven to be the right one.
PARENT_IDENTITY_UNREADABLE: Hiring evidence: the parent page could not be identified.
PINNED_BLOCK_MISMATCH: The pinned block is not the one expected, so nothing is written.
ROLE_NOT_UNIQUE: More than one role matches the auto-close.
SNAPSHOT_INVALID: The stored snapshot is not valid.
SNAPSHOT_STALE: Hiring evidence: the snapshot is stale.
STALE_SOURCE: The source changed since the screen was opened.
STORE_INVALID: The stored data is not valid.
TITLE_DRIFT: The page title no longer matches, so nothing is written.
WRONG_PAGE: The page is not the expected one, so nothing is written.
